spanish: Y si volviere la plaga y brotare en la casa después de sacar las piedras, y después de raspar la casa, y después de enlucir,

findings.issue: Piel perfect 3ms (a masculine singular actor removed the stones) is rendered as the infinitive sacar, which drops person and the actor.
Niphal infinitive (be plastered) is rendered as the active infinitive enlucir, changing stem force.

notes: אחר plus a finite 3ms is not the same construction as the two following infinitives.
